TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Caust.]
Taste : greasy ; putrid ; bitter ; sour ; as from disordered stomach.
Stuttering, difficult, indistinct speech. θ Chorea. θ Pertussis. θ Hemiplegia.
Speechlessness, from paralysis of organs of speech.
Tongue coated white on both sides, red in middle. θ Epilepsy.
Intolerable soreness of tongue as if scalded.
Painful vesicles on tip of tongue.
Paralysis of tongue.
Pain in tongue as if he had bitten it.
Bites tongue during attack. θ Epilepsy.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Caust.]
Dryness of mouth and tongue.
Swelling of inner side of cheek ; he bites it when chewing.
Induration on inside of cheek. θ Herpes on cheek.
Saliva runs from mouth, more after eating. θ Toothache. θ Paralysis.
Much phlegm in mouth and throat. θ Pertussis.
Froth at mouth. θ Epilepsy.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Caust.]
Redness of uvula and fauces.
Soreness and burning in fauces. θ Angina. θ Pertussis.
Sore, painful spot on hard palate.
Torn feeling in throat during mental exertion.
Jerking pain in throat.
Burning and rawness in throat, with sensation like heartburn.
Burning pain in throat ; not caused by swallowing ; on both sides, seemed to arise from chest.
Rawness and tickling in throat, with dry cough and some expectoration after long coughing.
Roughness and scraping in throat. θ Pertussis.
Pain in tonsils. θ Hemiplegia of face.
Dryness in throat, posteriorly. θ Aphonia.
Dryness in throat, noticed when swallowing, followed by scraping along down throat.
Tickling sensation in throat. θ Aphonia.
Sensation of a lump in throat, or as of food lodging in œsophagus.
Pressure in throat pit as of a foreign body.
Pain in throat, < by stooping.
Sensation as if something cold was rising in throat.
Must swallow continually, feels as if throat was too narrow.
Constant disposition to swallow, > while eating, < after. θ Diarrhœa.
Mucus collects in throat, cannot be raised by hawking ; is obliged to swallow it. θ Pertussis.
Constant desire to clear throat.
Hawking of mucus from pharynx and posterior nares.
Hawking of mucus, with pain in pit of throat.
Phlegm in throat, which she is unable to hawk up, and which sickens her. θ During pregnancy.
Throat reddened, with increase of mucus. θ Deafness.
Swelling, like goitre, on throat.
Rheumatic sore throat.
Sore throat, with drawing in right leg.
Paralysis of œsophagus.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Caust.]
Sits down to table with some appetite, but can scarcely eat a morsel. θ Pregnancy.
Ravenous hunger, takes food in a hurried manner. θ Dentition.
Appetite either too great, or none at all. θ Epilepsy.
No appetite. θ Hemiplegia. θ Gastric headache.
Hunger : after nausea ; causes headache.
No appetite in the morning.
Want of appetite and thirst.
Great thirst for several days.
No thirst. θ Prosopalgia.
Thirst : after eating ; for cold drinks ; with aversion to drink ; with scanty urine.
Desire for beer ; for smoked meat.
Aversion to sweet things. θ Diarrhœa. θ Pertussis.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Caust.]
Eating is painful on account of sensitive gums, and in other cases difficult on account of lameness and stiffness of jaws.
After chewing meat, teeth ache as though blunt, at same time sensation as though shreds of meat were between teeth which he wishes to remove.
Bread causes pressure in stomach.
Fresh meat causes nausea and waterbrash and renews the trouble ; smoked meat agrees. θ Diarrhœa.
Fat food disagrees, causes offensive belching. θ Epilepsy.
Coffee seems to aggravate every symptom. θ Pertussis.
After eating : feels relieved ; much thirst ; whooping cough worse ; pressure in whole abdomen ; sometimes disagreeable mucus in mouth ; eructation.
Collection of flatus in abdomen after a small meal.
Violent increase of pain after the least nourishment, or after tightening her clothes around her waist. θ Hysteralgia.
A swallow of cold water relieves. θ Pertussis. θ Spasms.
Acids cause inconvenience. θ Weak stomach.
